title: Concept: a build that never sets `RestoreLockedMode`
description: Directory.Build.props declares a lockfile that can be rewritten by a plain restore, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A verification or locking control is switched off, so the integrity guarantees the ecosystem offers are not applied here. This rule reads a lockfile that can be rewritten by a plain restore.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through Directory.Build.props (nuget).
risk: A verification or locking control is switched off, so the integrity guarantees the ecosystem offers are not applied here. This rule reads a lockfile that can be rewritten by a plain restore.
